title: Statuz StatuNode
description: JSON Schema for a node in the Arrow Map topology. Everything is a StatuNode — projects, components, files, agents, people, knowledge, resources.

id.description: Unique identifier for this node. May be a URI (statuz:node:<id>) or a local ID

type.description: The category of this node. Built-in types: project, component, file, agent, person, knowledge, resource. Custom types are allowed and should follow the pattern 'domain:type'.

description.description: Human-readable description of this node's role in the topology

_node_type_hint.description: Optional hint matching the node type.

labels.description: Optional labels for grouping and filtering

status.description: Current lifecycle status of this node

created_by.description: Who or what created this node entry

source.description: Where this node definition came from
